_comment: Edit this file to change how DOSBox-X starts. Paths can use forward slashes.
_cli_debug_flags_help: From: dosbox-x -helpdebug. -console shows log window on Windows. Set cli_debug_flags to [] to disable.
_debuggerrun_help: [log] debuggerrun=normal avoids CPU debugger freezing the game at startup
optional_commands_comment: Add extra -c DOS commands here (run before sb.exe). Launcher always runs d: then sb.exe last.
